description: Publish a compared Community template in the HyperCodeMotion Studio gallery, marked «Community», once its comparison with the original looks faithful. Takes the tracking code and notes on what is consciously different from the original and why. Its gallery videos are rendered and it then appears without manual review; get_proposal_status tells when.

notes.description: Up to 600 characters: what is consciously different from the original and why, or that nothing is.

name: publish_template
title: Publish a Community template
